Comment.value: Concerning Pipeweed strain (roadmap: concerning-pipeweed). Smoked at the water pipes of the Smoking Chamber; all effect comes from wg_bong.nss / pw_inc.nss, so it deliberately carries no item properties.

value.0:
Leaf from the walled garden of the Hornblowers themselves, cut and cured by the family and sold to almost nobody. Rare, dear, and worth it.

Smoked in a water pipe of the Smoking Chamber, it steadies the heart wonderfully against the dark -- and slows the hands to match.

Constitution +4, Dexterity -2, +2 on saving throws against fear, for one hour of real time. Resting will not clear it.
